issue.description:
# CI failure: 9231c9352 broke test_changed_query_incomplete_load_after_reconcile_rearms

## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/ace/tui/test_lazy_tier2_reconcile_apply.py::test_changed_query_incomplete_load_after_reconcile_rearms`

Deterministic and bisected to one commit. The failing assertion is
`assert app._agents_seen_complete_history is False` (actual `True`) after `apply_load` receives an
incomplete tier1 load whose `history_query_key` differs from the cached complete-history key.

Bisect (2026-09-20, workspace sase_32, master `244442ee8`): swapping the six src files changed by
`9231c9352` (`fix(tui): stop incomplete bounded loads from replacing a larger cache`) back to their
parent versions (`_state_init_agents.py`, `_loading_apply.py`, `_loading_compute_merge.py`,
`_loading_compute_types.py`, `_loading_state.py`, `repro/invariants.py`) makes all 11 tests in the
file pass; with HEAD versions this one fails. `9231c9352` did not touch this test file.

Decide which side is wrong: either the new `_loading_apply.py` behaviour lost the rule "a changed
committed query cannot reuse another query's full-history latch" (a real regression: fix the
code), or the new keep-the-larger-cache behaviour is intended and this test's expectation is stale
(update the test with a justification). Do not just loosen the assertion.
